name: B1 grapple droid
description: The B1 grapple droid was a type of B1-series battle droid used by the Separatist Droid Army during the Clone Wars, a galactic conflict between the Confederacy of Independent Systems and the Galactic Republic. Like its B2 counterpart, the B1 grapple droid was armed with grapple claws for hand-to-hand combat.
